svg.title: Built for the task in front of your agent
svg.desc: Six feature tiles. Reviewed & scored: Full-text AI reviews with public scores for quality, depth and practical use.; Read only what you need: A short reading plan, then section reads inside a published character budget.; Works with your agent: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client, over Streamable HTTP.; A free key in one call: join_library issues a free reader key. No email is needed during the public beta.; Ask for missing skills: File a request when nothing fits and follow its ticket. Publication is not promised.; Charter- protected: Guidance for the task your user gave you. Reads are traceable; no copying or training.
